电力开户、停用和搬家转户入口；先核对完整服务地址。: Start, stop, or transfer electric service here; check the full service address first.
这是发电服务选择；线路、搬家开户和账单仍由 PG&E 处理。: This is an electricity generation choice; PG&E still handles delivery, moving service requests, and billing.
在线提交开通或停用表格；建议提前 1–2 个工作日。: Submit a start or stop form online; allow 1–2 business days.
Novato 水务开户；搬出时另办理 Stop Service。: Start Novato water service here; submit a separate Stop Service request when moving out.
新开户先致电；建立账户后再注册网上缴费。: Call to start service; register for online bill payment after the account is established.
住宅水务开通或停用；按页面准备租约或产权及身份证明。: Start or stop residential water service; prepare the lease or ownership document and identification requested on the page.
开通或停用水与污水账户，请联系市 Utility Billing。: Contact City Utility Billing to start or stop water and wastewater accounts.
用于已有住宅水表的开户或停用；新装水表另走工程申请。: Use this for starting or stopping an account at an existing residential meter; a new meter needs a separate engineering application.
水与污水开户或停用，官网要求提前 3 个工作日联系。: The city asks for 3 business days of notice to start or stop water and wastewater service.
开户或停用先联系 Finance；网上缴费注册不等于开通水务。: Contact Finance to start or stop service; registering for online payment does not start water service.
本行为 Napa 市；Napa County 非建制地址须另查水务和垃圾服务区。: This row is for the City of Napa; unincorporated Napa County addresses require separate water and waste service-area checks.
2026 年 10 月 1 日起，水与污水网上缴费改用 Xpress Bill: Online water and wastewater bill payment moved to Xpress Bill Pay on October 1, 2026.
开通和停用须提交书面表格；市官网说明不接受电话直接办理。: Submit a written form to start or stop service; the city says it does not accept those requests by phone.
开户至少提前 2 个工作日；租客还需业主提交同意表。: Request service at least 2 business days ahead; tenants also need the owner to submit a consent form.
水、电、污水通过市 Utility Billing 联系。: Contact City Utility Billing for water, electricity, and wastewater accounts.
市营电力开户与水务共用此入口；不套用 PG&E／SCP 电力开户。: Municipal electricity and water use this same account-service contact; do not use the PG&E/SCP electricity setup process.
此为市水务客户门户；首次开户或搬家先联系 Utility Billing，缴费登: This is the city water customer portal. Contact Utility Billing for initial setup or a move; a payment login does not establish service.
水务开通或停用至少提前 1 个工作日联系。: Contact the city at least 1 business day before starting or stopping water service.
2025 年 7 月 1 日起接替 Recology；表格可选 New Serv: Replaced Recology on July 1, 2025; choose New Service or Closing an Account on the contact form.
此链接是官方零售供水商转介目录；请找 City of Sonoma 办理，Son: This link is an official retail-water-provider directory. Contact City of Sonoma; Sonoma Water itself does not open residential accounts in the city.
本行电力安排适用于市营服务范围；仅有 Healdsburg 邮寄地址仍应先核对实: The electricity arrangement here applies to the municipal service area; a Healdsburg mailing address alone does not establish eligibility.
Sonoma 市与 Sonoma County 不是同一服务范围；市外 Sono: The City of Sonoma and Sonoma County are different service areas; Sonoma Valley addresses outside the city need separate water-district and waste-hauler checks.
市官方 FAQ 列有垃圾服务商与电话；开户、转户或停用联系 Republic S: The city FAQ lists the hauler and phone number; contact Republic Services to start, move, or stop service.
先查本页供水区地图；此入口仅办理市营供水地址。: Check the service-area map on this page first; this contact covers city-operated water accounts only.
仅限 Cal Water 服务区；不能只按 Dixon 城市名选供水商。: For addresses in the Cal Water service area only; the city name Dixon is not enough to choose a water provider.
市网页可选 Start／End Service；致电选项 1，租客先确认账户持有: The city form offers Start/End Service. Use phone option 1; tenants should first confirm who will hold the account.
开通、停用和账单联系市 Finance；供水由 SSWA／Solano Irri: Contact City Finance for setup, termination, and billing; SSWA/Solano Irrigation District jointly provide water service.
选择 Start／Stop Water Service；工程接管申请不是搬家开户: Choose Start/Stop Water Service; an engineering connection application is a different process from setting up service for a move.
Dixon 有两家住宅供水单位，先用完整地址核对服务区。: Dixon has two residential water providers; verify the service area using the full address first.
